bet.text: A ground intake: match simulations right after kickoff showed defense would hurt a robot with only a source pickup, and a human player can launch coral towards the reef.

demand.text: The team says the systems it knew helped it cycle coral every match, get the coral ranking point and win.
A week one observer says it seemed to ignore climbing completely in favor of coral cycles.

auto.text: It picks coral up from the ground in auto, which the team says a skinny intake would have ruled out.
A newspaper lists the Autonomous Award.

cycle.text: A linebreak sees coral; the intake rises by itself, centers it and hands it to the arm.
The driver lets go of the sticks, the robot drives to the nearest branch, and the driver confirms.
Arm and elevator move down together with the bumpers against the reef.

endgame.text: No climber was added: the team was at maximum weight with little room.
By one count it was one of seven teams that played in the 2025 division playoffs without a deep climb.

gave_up.text: The climb: adding one before the championship meant lightening many parts, with about a week to make it and about one day with the robot.
A week one observer gave it no ability to do algae or climb; in April another credited its end effector with algae too.
Another says a climber was designed but left off in week one for mechanical or weight issues.

changed.text: A skinny intake came first, to avoid centering; it gave middling ground and source pickups, so the team went wide.
Before the championship it added LEDs and improved scoring, autos and the state machine.
In hindsight the A-frame should have reached the corners: the elevator had some wobble.

outcome.text: 53-12-0 in official play; ranked 21 by championship OPR (96.75, Newton).

functions.name: Ground intake

solves.text: Pick coral up away from the source, where defense makes a big difference, and center it for the arm

functions.type: wide ground intake with centering wheels and handoff to an arm

facts.text: One center linebreak: coral is centered by the time the intake is up
The upper wheels spin the coral while it is centered, so the centering wheels meet a changing surface
The bottom roller is kept from spinning; when it spun freely the coral just spun in the intake
Gorilla tape on the bottom axle did this all season, as new plates were not worth it
Tape on a wheel in the middle helps push the coral out
A perpendicular coral is grabbed, flops in as the robot rotates and gets centered
Two Kraken X60s; the team expected to change to X44s
A 111 post on adding this style of intake to its own robot says it would need a complete arm redesign there and left packaging issues for the climb

cost.text: Two Kraken X60s are a lot of weight, the team says
In some matches the arm was not centered at handoff, so coral was grabbed off center; the team is pretty sure that is why coral got thrown out

solves.text: Carry the arm to the scoring heights with a system the team had already practiced building

facts.text: A second robot built in the 2024 off-season for experience had basically this elevator; the team solved many of its problems here
Two open-ended belts, about 13.5 ft long
Two motors with 9-tooth pinions on 36-tooth gears, each on a shaft with a 24-tooth pulley
Belts are clamped on the carriage between aluminum and a profiled PLA part
Carriage weight about 7 lb; with the arm, about
Zeroed by current sensing

cost.text: Some wobble; the robot wobbled when it braked while extending a couple of times

functions.name: Arm and manipulator

solves.text: Place coral on either side of the robot without ever hitting the reef or the belly pan

functions.type: rotating arm with a roller manipulator

facts.text: Pivot reduction
Manipulator roller reduction, about
Range limits are given differently: 700 degrees in March, for safety; 580 in the release thread, short of where the power wires would break
A 2.22 ratio on the absolute encoder gives 800 degrees and tells turns apart; it is not a whole number on purpose, and is used only to initialize the arm
Software mirrors the angle to the side nearer the reef, prefers to rotate away from it, and clamps moves through the reef or into the belly pan
Arm and elevator wait for each other through an interpolation table taken from CAD
Current sensing tells whether it holds coral
Wires pass through the pivot tube in wire wrap with slack to twist; printed parts inside keep the aluminum from shredding the wrap
Scoring moves the arm down with the elevator while the bumpers rest on the reef; the robot does not move

functions.name: Auto align and vision

solves.text: Line up with the branch although scoring is offset from the center of the robot

functions.type: full-field pose estimate with driver-confirmed auto align

facts.text: Four OV9281 cameras on two Orange Pi 5s running PhotonVision, at 800 by 600 and about 40 fps
The branch is chosen by weighted rotation and translation distance
Most camera time went into positions, mounts and lenses that see tags from as close as possible
The team says an equivalent setup with LL3Gs would have cost it $1600

functions.name: Monolithic state machine

solves.text: Make a complicated handoff and scoring sequence predictable

functions.type: one state machine for every subsystem

facts.text: Every state holds set points for intake, elevator, arm and rollers, with an explicit list of transitions
Written in Kotlin, which the team has used since 2020

decisions.because: match simulations showed defense would make a big difference at the source
the team knew it from 2024 and it allows ground pickup in auto
decisions.instead_of: a skinny intake that avoids centering

decisions.because: the robot was at maximum weight with little room, and before the championship there was about a week to make an untested one
scoring is offset from the center of the robot

decisions.choice: Keep the bottom roller from spinning
decisions.because: it makes the handoff and trough scoring better

decisions.choice: Gearbox shafts turned down from hex
decisions.because: smaller 0.875 in bearings make gearboxes compact, and the shafts add rigidity between plates
decisions.instead_of: hex bearings and shaft end screws
decisions.cost: about a week of lathe work for a student
